general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Blended Learning, Student-centered theory, Active Learning
general_information.Description: This course will introduce the student to the essential aspects of information assurance and incident response (IR). The student will be provided with the tools, techniques and industry accepted methodologies so that upon completion of the course the student will be able to describe key concepts of network security and IR and how those concepts apply to themselves and their organization. The course is based on Courses 3 and 5 of the SSCP Professional Training Certificate, the whole will show employers you have the IT security foundation to defend against cyber attacks – and puts you on a clear path to earning SSCP certification.
general_information.StudentTasks: Student must get the certification of CertNexus Certified Ethical Emerging Technologist Professional Certificate (CertNexus) specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination
general_information.Note: 1. Complete two online courses 3, 5 to be allowed to take Final Exam 2. Final Exam is the Final Theory Exam (TE): 100% 3. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & (Final TE Score + bonus) >= 5

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Describe processes for operating and maintaining monitoring systems
Understand the IR and recovery process
Describe the supporting role in forensic investigations, BC and DRP processes
Understand security issues related to networks
Identify protective measures for telecommunication technologies and define processes for controlling network access
Identify processes for managing LAN-based security and describe procedures for operating and configuring networked-based security devices
Define procedures to implement and operate wireless technologies
